name: avr-asm-formatter
description: Column-aligns AVR assembly (label / mnemonic / operands / comment) without ever rewriting the inside of a token, so X+/-Y/Z+q addressing survives formatting intact.

avrAsmFormatter.filePatterns.description: Glob patterns of files this formatter applies to. Works regardless of which extension owns syntax highlighting for these files.

avrAsmFormatter.mnemonicColumn.description: Column where the mnemonic/directive starts (labels live at column 0).

avrAsmFormatter.commentMinSpacing.description: Minimum spaces before a comment when the code already runs past commentColumn.

avrAsmFormatter.alignCommentOnlyLines.description: Re-indent whole-line comments to the mnemonic column instead of leaving their original indentation.

avrAsmFormatter.mnemonicCase.description: Force the case of the mnemonic/directive token. Operands are never touched.
